200.description:
The confirmation page, or the "you are signed out" page when there
is nowhere to send the user. HTML.

302.description:
Signed out, redirecting to the registered
`post_logout_redirect_uri` with `state` echoed.

400.description:
The `post_logout_redirect_uri` is not registered for this client,
or the client is unknown. **Nothing about the session has changed**,
and no redirect is issued.
